$comment: M68: versioned content contract for data/<namespace>/anomaly_room/*.json. Same JSON shape as dungeon_room.schema.json: loaded by the same DungeonRoomMeta.fromJson parser and the same door jigsaw validation, into a separate manifest (RoomManifest.currentAnomaly) so a themed query never surfaces a deliberately foreign room. Identity is the resource id namespace + the relative path with the .json suffix stripped. All field semantics, including spanY, content dispatch and the situation tag vocabulary, are identical to dungeon_room.schema.json; see that file for the full field table.

version.$comment: Content contract version this file declares. 1 is the only generation this round ships.
